description: Hard-to-follow async code. Profile.jsx chains four .then() calls with arrow callbacks such as `.then((res) => res.json())` — the old regex read call arguments as `[^)]*` and stopped at the first `)`, so it missed nearly every real chain. server/routes/avatar.js nests four error-first Node callbacks; the rule only follows .then() chains, so nested callbacks are a known gap.
